in_sanskrit.name: हेमपुष्प
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name is derived from Sanskrit, where 'Hema' means 'gold' or 'wealth', and 'Pushpa' means 'flower'. So, the full meaning of the name is 'Golden Flower'.

in_hindi.name: हेमपुष्पा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name in Hindi is 'हेमपुष्पा' (hemapushpa), which translates to 'Sona Phool' in English, meaning 'Golden Flower'.

in_tamil.name: ஹேமபுஷ்பா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name in Tamil is 'ஹேமபுஷ்பா' (hemapushpa), which translates to 'Konguzhil Poojai' in English, meaning 'Golden Flower Worship'.

in_telugu.name: హేమపుష్ప
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name in Telugu is 'హేమపుష్ప' (hemapushpa), which translates to 'Godari Phool' in English, meaning 'Golden Flower'.

in_marathi.name: Hemapushpa
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemapushpa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hema means gold or wealth, Pushpa means lotus flower. This name is derived from the Hindu mythology and represents prosperity, beauty, and purity.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lotus Flower
